integrity: The general phase and crossover theorems have an analytical proof. Finite computations cross-check examples and rigorously enclose one numerical root but do not prove the universal statements. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Plug-flow one-dimensional linear oxygen-deficit model, zero initial deficit, only one continuously decreasing positive demand source with nondecreasing fractional decay hazard; one abrupt downstream decrease in constant reaeration rate, no new pollutant at interface. No dispersion, saturation feedback, sediment demand, extra sources, or field calibration. Historical priority provisional.
title: Two oxygen sags from one outfall: a unique worst-reach switch under a reaeration drop
